Pathfinder Toolkit › Bestiary › Level 3

Giant Scorpion

Creature 3 Largeanimal

Perception +9; darkvision, tremorsense (imprecise) 60 feet

Skills Athletics +11, Stealth +7

Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int −5, Wis +2, Cha −4

AC 18; Fort +12, Ref +9, Will +7

HP 45

Reactive Strike (Stinger Only) ⤾ When a foe in reach moves away, uses a manipulate action, or makes a ranged attack, it can Strike that foe.

Speed 40 feet

Melee ◆ pincer +11 [+7/+3] (agile, reach 10 feet), Damage 1d8+6 slashing plus Grab

Melee ◆ stinger +11 [+6/+1] (reach 10 feet), Damage 1d6+6 piercing plus Giant Scorpion Venom

Constrict ◆ 1d6+4 bludgeoning, DC 20 basic Fortitude

Deals the listed damage to every creature it has grabbed or restrained (basic Fortitude save).

Giant Scorpion Venom (poison) Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d10 poison damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d10 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d10 poison damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Grab ◆ After a hit, it grabs the target for free (the target is grabbed until it Escapes).
